core_categories: Medical/Surgical Supplies; Capital Equipment and Furnishings; Specialty Products and Pharmaceuticals; HCS Branded Medical Supplies
specialty_focus: Concordance Healthcare Solutions is a broad-line independent healthcare distributor in the United States, managing supply chain logistics, contracts, and distribution for medical supplies, devices, and capital equipment. It serves the entire continuum of care, including acute care hospitals, IDNs, physician practices, surgery centers, outpatient clinics, long-term care facilities, government and VA institutions, and home care, hospice, and community health organizations. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
